data.one_liner: A lightweight wrapper around InheritedWidget for state management
data.what_it_does: Provider exposes values via InheritedWidgets, simplifying resource allocation, lazy loading, and rebuilds. It offers convenient context extensions like watch, read, and select for consuming state.
use_when: Simple state management with ChangeNotifier or ValueNotifier
Small to medium apps needing dependency injection
When you want devtools visibility of provider state
avoid_when: Large, complex state that benefits from advanced patterns like Riverpod or Bloc
When you need code generation for models or forms
weaknesses: Limited to InheritedWidget under the hood, may feel less modern than Riverpod
Can become verbose for many providers

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a more modern, testable, and feature‑rich approach to state management and dependency injection, with null safety and code generation support.
